expectations.text: Names at least one fintech benchmark (Stripe, Mercury, Ramp, or Wise) together with a specific borrowed mechanic, not just the product name
expectations.evidence: Cites Stripe (transaction table: right-aligned tabular amounts, 44px rows, status dot not pill), Mercury (money-as-typography for the summary strip), Ramp (amount in context via counterparty/payment method). Each name carries a named mechanic.

expectations.text: The generated prompt's content inventory preserves all four currently rendered data points (date, description, amount, status)
expectations.evidence: Content inventory lists date, description, amount+currency, status for all three example rows; audit table maps each to created_at / description / amount_cents / status.

expectations.text: Identifies data already in the API response but not rendered today (currency, counterparty, payment_method, or has_more pagination)
expectations.evidence: Section 'In the response but not rendered' lists currency (mis-rendered as hardcoded $), counterparty.name/id, payment_method, and has_more with no pagination control.

expectations.text: The prompt block is self-contained — it does not reference file paths, the codebase, or other sections of the document a design tool cannot see
expectations.evidence: Prompt block opens with 'Product and user' and carries its own example values; no file paths, no reference to the audit or other document sections.

expectations.text: Proposes at least one additive API change with a method and path (or an optional field on the existing endpoint) plus a response shape, explicitly marked non-breaking
expectations.evidence: GET /api/transactions/summary (new) with total_in_cents/total_out_cents/pending_count/currency, 'Non-breaking: new endpoint', and 'Degrades to: the summary strip is omitted entirely until this ships'.

expectations.text: Does not propose removing, renaming, or changing the type of any existing field in GET /api/transactions
expectations.evidence: No existing field altered. Prompt explicitly forbids replacing row-click navigation with inline expansion, and the invariants list pins amount_cents/100 and raw status values.
